instruction: Pick up the cube and hold it still at the green goal point.

outcome.real_measurement: At the goal: cube centre within 2.5 cm of the goal point at every judged step (ManiSkill's goal_thresh). Real world: tracked cube pose vs the goal point.
Held by the robot: robot-cube contact impulse > 0 in every judged step (substep-accumulated; something must carry the cube's weight). Real world: gripper current / F-T.
Held between the fingers: enclosure clearance <= 2 mm at every judged step (the cube is not perched on a finger). Real world: in-hand camera / gripper width vs cube.
Not resting on the table: no table-cube contact in the judged window. Real world: side camera / depth.
Picked up (process): the cube's lowest point was >= 5 cm above the table at some step of the episode, so pushing it to a low goal does not count. Real world: side camera.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the cube centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: grasp, lift 10 cm, carry the cube centre to the goal, hold still

counterexamples.name: drop_at_goal
counterexamples.description: carry to the goal; the policy's last action is the gripper-open command (the cube falls after the policy ends)

counterexamples.name: place_under_goal
counterexamples.description: put the cube on the table under the goal, release, retreat

counterexamples.name: near_miss
counterexamples.description: hold the cube still 4 cm (horizontally) from the goal

counterexamples.name: no_op
counterexamples.description: the arm stays at its start pose

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: |cube - goal| <= 2.5 cm and robot joint speeds <= 0.2 rad/s at the evaluated step (no grasp, no settle)

notes: No release (the goal is held in the air): require_released false; the held terms say who carries the cube. Settle (hold A) holds the arm and keeps the gripper's last (closing) command.
